topic: Marco Ferreira Logistics Check-In — Lisbon Press Trip (Post-Trip Follow-Up)
summary:
Post-trip logistics check-in between Nina Caldwell and Marco Ferreira (Visit Lisbon Partnerships). Key action items resolved during call:

**ACTION ITEMS — AUTHORITATIVE (Meeting Summary)**

1. [NINA] Submit final invoice for Visit Lisbon press trip sponsorship fee (€2,400) to marco.ferreira@visitlisbon-partnerships.example by 2026-05-27. Invoice must reference contract ref VL-2026-NC-04 and include bank transfer details.

2. [MARCO] Send Nina the official Visit Lisbon brand asset pack (hi-res logos, approved destination photography, brand usage guidelines) by 2026-05-23 so Nina can begin content production.

3. [NINA] Deliver first draft of the long-form Lisbon feature article (min. 1,200 words) to marco.ferreira@visitlisbon-partnerships.example for review by 2026-06-04. Draft must include at least 3 embedded destination photography credits per contract Section 2.1.

4. [MARCO] Confirm the official Visit Lisbon social media handles and preferred hashtag set for Nina's Instagram and newsletter content by 2026-05-23 (same send as brand asset pack, or separate email).

5. [NINA] Schedule and publish the sponsored newsletter issue featuring Lisbon content no later than 2026-06-05 (Thursday cadence). Must include FTC-compliant sponsorship disclosure in header per Nina's Partnership Standards & Disclosure Policy (NPAG-1).

6. [NINA] Send Marco a content preview link (draft newsletter + article URL) at least 48 hours before publication for courtesy review — not contractual approval, per Section 3.4 of contract.

7. [MARCO] Provide written confirmation of receipt of Nina's invoice within 2 business days of submission, and confirm expected payment processing timeline (net-30 per contract).

Discussion notes: Marco confirmed the Algarve Coast Campaign contract addendum (Section 4.2 NDA clause) is still under internal legal review. Nina reiterated she cannot proceed with that addendum as written. Marco agreed to revert with a revised clause or formal withdrawal by 2026-05-28. This item is separate from the Lisbon press trip deliverables and does not affect the current invoice or content schedule.
